hooks.commandWindows: $d=(Get-Location).Path; while ($d) { if (Test-Path (Join-Path $d 'LEARNING.md')) { "Learning mode: LEARNING.md found at $d\LEARNING.md."; "Use the 'learning-mode' skill for every non-trivial change this session.
